headline: Swiss Firms Plan China Investment Expansion as Trade Ties Deepen
summary: Swiss companies are planning to expand their investments in China as bilateral trade agreements strengthen economic ties between the nations.
why: Cross-border corporate investment trends illustrate how geopolitical trade pacts influence multinational capital allocation strategies.
